parse.title: Locus Award for Best Novel
parse.wikitext:
{{Short description|Literary award by the science fiction and fantasy magazine Locus}}
Winners of the '''Locus Award for Best Novel''', one of several discontinued [[Locus Award]]s, awarded by ''[[Locus (magazine)|Locus]]'' magazine. Awards presented in a given year are for works published in the previous calendar year.

The award for Best Novel was presented from 1971 (when the awards began) to 1979. Since 1980, awards have been presented for [[Locus Award for Best Science Fiction Novel|Best Science Fiction Novel]] and [[Locus Award for Best Fantasy Novel|Best Fantasy Novel]].
